description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 me 2 tualete, i pozicionuar tek Ish Parku Autobusave.
Apartamenti ndodhet në katin e 4-t, me sipërfaqe totale 126.07 m² dhe neto 102.8 m².
Organizimi përfshin ambient gatimi, ambient ndenjeje, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe dy ballkone, ku njëri ofron akses nga salloni dhe tjetri nga dhoma e gjumit.
Per me shume na kontaktoni
description_en: 2+1 apartment with 2 bathrooms for sale, located at the former Bus Park. The apartment is located on the 4th floor, with a total area of ​​126.07 m² and a net area of ​​102.8 m². The arrangement includes a kitchen area, a living area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two balconies, where one offers access from the living room and the other from the bedroom. For more, contact us
